```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

paths_file <- file.path("..", "..", "analysis", "R", "paths.R")

if (!file.exists(paths_file)) {
  paths_file <- file.path("analysis", "R", "paths.R")
}

source(paths_file)
```

```{r load-data}
western_power_csv <- thermal_raw_path(
  "western_power",
  "western_power_air_pollutants_generation.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(western_power_csv)) {
  stop(
    "Western Power raw CSV not found. Run ",
    "`python -m nzk_aphiam.data.scrape.thermal.western_power` first.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

western_power <- read.csv(
  western_power_csv,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r overview}
str(western_power)
head(western_power)
summary(western_power)
```

```{r records-by-plant}
table(western_power$발전소, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r records-by-year}
western_power$year <- substr(western_power$날짜, 1, 4)
table(western_power$year, useNA = "ifany")
```
